definition: The vector $\boldsymbol{v} \times \boldsymbol{w} = \lvert\boldsymbol{v}\rvert\lvert\boldsymbol{w}\rvert\sin\theta\,\boldsymbol{n}$, perpendicular to both $\boldsymbol{v}$ and $\boldsymbol{w}$, whose length is the area of the parallelogram they form; also called the cross product.

The rule that fixes the direction of $\boldsymbol{v} \times \boldsymbol{w}$: curl the fingers of your right hand from $\boldsymbol{v}$ towards $\boldsymbol{w}$ and your thumb points along $\boldsymbol{v} \times \boldsymbol{w}$.
